observations: Photo 0: A DSLR camera body with 'Nikon' logo and 'D7100' model name printed on the pentaprism housing, body cap on, sitting in front of a worn cardboard box also printed 'Nikon'.
Photo 1: Same camera held in a hand, rear/mount side shown with body cap removed, mirror box visible, box behind it printed 'D7100' and 'Nikon'.
No batteries visible in either photo.
No silicone case visible in either photo.
No lens attached in either photo; only body cap and rear cap shown.
No screen-on, power-on, shutter-fire, or sensor shot provided to confirm function.

claims.evidence: Both photo 0 and photo 1 clearly show 'Nikon' branding and 'D7100' model markings on the body and box.

claims.claim: The camera is working perfectly fine.
claims.evidence: No power-on, screen, shutter-fire, or sensor/lens test shot provided.
No batteries visible in either photo.
No case visible in either photo; camera appears bare with only body/rear caps.

risks.risk: Seller's stated brand (Canon) does not match the item shown (Nikon D7100), raising doubt about whether seller actually has the item pictured or is reusing stock photos/description from another listing.
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the camera with a handwritten note/date and seller's face or name, matching the stated brand, or a corrected listing.
risks.if_unproven: as a mismatched/unverified listing, not priced until identity is confirmed by seller

risks.risk: Functional status unknown (sensor, shutter count, autofocus, LCD, buttons).
risks.proof: Video of camera powering on, displaying a live image on screen, and firing shutter.

risks.risk: No lens included, affects usability and value.
risks.proof: Photo confirming whether a lens is included or body-only sale.

risks.risk: Accessories (2 batteries, silicone case) claimed but not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of the batteries and case laid out next to the camera.

risks.risk: Shutter count / sensor wear unknown, common issue in used DSLRs.
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or EXIF data of a test shot.
risks.if_unproven: priced at high shutter count assumption

proof_requests: A corrected, accurate description matching the Nikon D7100 shown in photos.
Video of the camera powering on and firing the shutter.
Photo of the 2 batteries and silicone case next to the camera.
Photo or screenshot showing shutter count from the camera menu.
Confirmation of whether a lens is included.
response.reason: The seller states the brand is Canon, but both photos clearly show a Nikon D7100 body and matching box, a direct contradiction between words and visual evidence that raises doubt about the listing's accuracy or whether it was copied from elsewhere.
